notes: Unlike English ('to be afraid'), French uses the verb 'avoir' (to have) with the noun 'peur' (never say 'je suis peur').
Use the preposition 'de' before a noun or an infinitive to say what you are afraid of (e.g., 'avoir peur du noir', 'avoir peur de tomber').
